user.title: Join a neighbourhood
user.description: Paste the join code you were given. It contains everything needed to connect, so there is nothing else to configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Rejoin the neighbourhood
reauth_confirm.description: This property's credential was revoked or rotated. Paste the new join code.

error.invalid_join_code: That join code could not be used: {reason}
error.wrong_property: That join code is for a different property.

abort.already_configured: This property is already connected to that neighbourhood.

init.title: What this property publishes
init.description: Neighbourhood Watch does not arm anything itself. Point it at the entities you already use, and it publishes the roll-up.

data_description.armed_entity: The entity that says this property is armed, for example your night watch input boolean or alarm panel.
data_description.trigger_entities: Person detection sensors that should raise an alert while armed.
data_description.alert_hold: How long a trigger must stay on before it counts. Filters out the split second false positives cameras produce.
data_description.alert_linger: How long an alert keeps showing after the last detection, so someone waking up later still sees it.
data_description.share_detail: Whether neighbours see which camera fired, or only that an alert happened.
data_description.picture: Optional photo for this property's tile. An icon is used if empty.

rejected.title: Neighbourhood Watch credential rejected
rejected.description: The relay rejected this property ({reason}). Ask the neighbourhood owner for a new join code, then reconfigure the integration.

panic.name: Panic
panic.description: Raise a panic across the neighbourhood.

entry_id.name: Hood
entry_id.description: Which neighbourhood to raise. Leave empty for all.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Clear a latched panic and any lingering alert.

entry_id.name: Hood
entry_id.description: Which neighbourhood to clear. Leave empty for all.
